description:
[read-only] The lead inbox, newest first: leads from Meta lead ads and (for flayr staff) the site form, each with its stage (new, contacted, qualified, won, lost), owner, and the ad, form and campaign it came from. A field Meta did not report is null ("not reported"). Contact details appear only when the brand stores lead details. Read-only.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/leads.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) to see one brand's leads. Omitted: every lead the key owner receives. A brand-bound key is pinned to its brand.

name: ads_leads_list
